crossRefs.note: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will…
“But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says Yahweh: “I will put my law…
They will no longer each teach his neighbor, and every man teach his brother, saying, ‘Know Yahweh;’ for they will all…
Let’s acknowledge Yahweh. Let’s press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come…
Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and…
But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap…
“The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly…
Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa, and get Simon, who is…
who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’
Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind…
Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that…
Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

translations.web: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from myself.
translations.bsb: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
translations.kjv: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
translations.asv: If any man willeth to do his will, he shall know of the teaching, whether it is of God, or whether I speak from myself.
